title: Connection setup
save: Save the connection with the endpoint and credentials from your supplier.
test: Test it explicitly to check access. Discovery does not prove generation, delivery or available credit.
activate: Activate only where needed: writing provider, media storage or backup storage. Saving alone does not activate it.
ai: Choose the API adapter and an exact model offered by your provider. OpenAI-compatible can also use a different supplier’s API base URL.
fill_help: Fills an empty endpoint for the selected AI adapter only. Your custom or saved URL is never replaced. Review the model and credentials before saving.
mcp: Copy the remote HTTP MCP endpoint supplied by your provider. There is no universal MCP URL. Testing lists tools; generation requires a separate reviewed Studio binding.
s3: Copy the S3 API endpoint, bucket, region and scoped credentials from your storage provider. A bucket website or public media URL is not the API endpoint.
r2: R2 uses region auto. Copy the exact account and jurisdiction endpoint from Cloudflare; do not substitute your public bucket URL.
storage: First save an S3 connection, then explicitly test it. Choose media or encrypted backups here as separate destinations; credentials and bucket policy must suit that purpose.
kind_fixed: Create a new connection to use a different type.
ai_conflict: AI settings changed elsewhere. Your proposal is retained; reload and review before saving.
storage_conflict: Storage changed elsewhere. No destination was disabled. Reload Storage and review the active destination.
